{{Marvel|url=articles/comics/star-wars-shadow-of-maul-prequel-comic-maul-shadow-lord-animated-series|text=The 'Star Wars: Shadow of Maul' Comic Series Establishes the World of the Upcoming Animated Show}} establishes the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadow of Maul]]'' take place between the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] and the events of ''[[Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord]]''. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the Empire's formation to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of {{#if: {{{1|}}}|[[Shadow of Maul {{{1|}}}|''Shadow of Maul'' {{{1|}}}]]|''Star Wars: Shadow of Maul''}}{{#if: {{{2|}}}|, including {{{2}}},|}} must take place during or after 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].<noinclude>

<code><nowiki>{{ShadowofMaulDate}}</nowiki></code>
